title: No Head Necessary
problem: one 50% roll for all dead holders
notes: | 2026-10-26 realign (text is the contract): text claims "While this creature is dead, it has a 50% chance to attack". Fix: H: roll 50% per dead holder (bc_CreatureStartOfTurn L5076-L5080; currently one shared roll, then every dead holder attacks). vs bugged: neutral on average (less correlated). | In-game test: several dead No Head Necessary holders: each rolls its own 50% (sometimes one attacks and another doesn't) instead of all or none.

release_notes.intended: While dead, each holder has a 50% chance to attack enemies at the start of their turns.
release_notes.actual: In the unpatched game, one roll decided for every dead holder at once (all or none).
release_notes.fix: Now each dead holder rolls its own 50% chance.
